scenarios.name: two-writer-concurrent-insert
scenarios.notes: Both writers insert at offset 5 concurrently from the same base; YATA ordering decides the interleaving deterministically.

scenarios.name: snapshot-plus-concurrent-residual
scenarios.notes: A full-state snapshot is a valid delta; a concurrent residual published after a squash must merge in, not vanish.

scenarios.name: unicode-content
scenarios.notes: Yjs text offsets are UTF-16 code units; expectedText is the plain JS string for comparison after full application.

scenarios.name: deletion-only-tail
scenarios.notes: The second delta carries only delete-set changes; appliers must handle structless updates.
